scientific_integrity: An analytic proof establishes exactly three nondegenerate positive extrema only for all sufficiently large temperature ratios with hot-area weight inverse-square temperature-ratio. Finite computations are supplemental; independent scientific audit is not performed.

title: Two-temperature Planck spectra: three modes and a logarithmic spectral notch
